# World v1 fixture

Unmodified `partitions.world` captured from the native SillyTavern interop run:
`output/playwright/roll-native-gate/data/default-user/user/files/LittleWhiteBox_OS_39977a76-2a98-4457-8090-33e4166616cb.json`, revision 13.

The frozen upstream v1 format owns `version`, `subscribed`, `injectToStory`, `overview`, and `news`. Its article limits are 8 articles, 64 code points for IDs/titles, 120 for summaries, 800 for bodies, and 320 for overview. V2 keeps content only. Conversion deliberately does not choose one chat's preferences as global preferences.
